I confirmed by rendering that nothing visible changed: every screen below reads the same as the f05e640db pass. Seeding Mara and Tobin through the changed RitualFactory produced the expected knowledge rows (Mara's Vigil to Mara, Tobin's Vigil to Tobin, Rite of Quiet to both). Rituals page: as Mara the page lists Mara's Vigil under the header Your anima ritual and Rite of Quiet under Known rituals, and Tobin's Vigil is absent (y01 Mara); as Tobin the mirror holds (y01 Tobin). The list request returned, for Mara, Mara's Vigil (SCENE_ACTION, viewer_can_edit true) and Rite of Quiet (SERVICE, viewer_can_edit false); for Tobin, Rite of Quiet and Tobin's Vigil (viewer_can_edit true). The Edit control shows in Mara's Manage panel (y02). Screen 1: two pill pickers with hints, labels What you feel when you perform it and What it does to the other person, Primal pills orange, Celestial cyan, Abyssal violet, a neutral None pill, and a Set resonances button that is grey with nothing picked and dark once both are picked (y03, y04); after Set resonances the form shows two read-only dashed boxes (Hollow in the Primal ink, Ruin in the Abyssal ink) and a ghost Attune button, and the database read back primal 1 and outward 3 (y05); the dark theme keeps the inks readable (y07). Screen 4: title Attune your ritual, both pickers with the current picks bold, the cost rows Anima 2, Resonance cost 5, Action points 10, Roll CheckType3, and Cancel (y06, y08); with the picks switched to Marrow and Dawn the Attune button turns filled and the row reads Resonance cost (Marrow, Dawn) (y09). Attune is grey while the picks equal the current ones (y06, y08), so the filled button of the demo's Screen 4 shows only after a pick changes. Screen 2: the card reads Mara's ritual reached for your ruin. Did it take hold of you?, a filled Endorse, an outlined Withhold and the line Mara's ritual leaves you wearier. above the feed, in light and dark. The card showed on Tobin's live page about 6 seconds after Tobin typed accept, with no reload (z-live-card-without-reload), and after a typed ritual withhold Mara it cleared within about 3 seconds while the line You do not endorse Mara's ritual for Ruin. appeared in his feed; the f05e640db report had left both of these unobserved. Screen 3: Mara reads Your ritual feeds on Tobin. You recover 6 anima. Your Hollow grows by 3., then Tobin felt it. Your Ruin grows by 3. after Endorse (z-light Mara), or Tobin did not feel it. after Withhold (z-dark Mara). Hollow and Ruin stand in for the demo's Thrill and Dread and both amounts are 3 because the seeded aura is 50 to 50. In the withhold run Mara read You recover 2 anima, because her anima stood at 8 of 10 and the line states what she actually recovered. Partner wording: the Endorse button's answer returned {"detail":"You endorse Mara's ritual for Ruin."} (HTTP 200) and the typed command ritual withhold Mara printed You do not endorse Mara's ritual for Ruin. in Tobin's feed. Colour guard: in the feed line Mara's ritual reached for your ruin. Did it take hold of you? Type ritual endorse Mara or ritual withhold Mara. the command names are white markup. In the light theme the span has class font-semibold text-foreground and computes to rgb(9, 9, 11) on a white ground; in the dark theme it computes to rgb(250, 250, 250) on rgb(9, 9, 11). Both are bold and readable in the shots. Database read-back after the three scenes: performance rows endorsed, withheld, withheld; Mara's Hollow 20 to 23 and Ruin 20 to 23 after the endorsed scene, Hollow 23 to 26 with Ruin unchanged at 23 after the withheld scene. Observations outside the demo, none a defect against it: Mara's lines carry the red [NARRATIVE] tag the feed puts on every system notice, which the demo's Screen 3 does not draw and this branch does not touch; the Edit dialog's Stat ID, Skill ID and Check Type ID boxes are empty on the existing form even though the config has a stat, which is not a demo element; the Endorse button draws no line to Tobin's feed (the line is only in the response body); the captured request headers for the Rituals list showed no X-Character-ID header although the response was scoped per character, and I did not trace how the character was chosen (each account here plays one character). The server log for the runs holds 59 Service Unavailable lines for /api/clock/ and one Evennia error, 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'at_object_receive', raised at a player's automatic puppeting on login for a seeded character with no home; neither is on a ritual path.`

As Mara: Manage, Edit on a ritual with no picks, picked Hollow and Ruin, pressed Set resonances, saw the picks lock and Attune appear, opened Attune, read the cost rows, switched the picks to Marrow and Dawn, cancelled; repeated the editor and Attune in the dark theme. In a started scene Mara typed ritual anima Tobin. As Tobin: opened the scene page and pressed Accept, read the live feed (consent line, fatigue line, endorsement prompt), read the card after a reload, pressed Endorse and read the answer body; in a second scene typed ritual withhold Mara in the dark theme; in a third scene typed accept, waited with no reload for the card, then typed ritual withhold Mara and waited for the card to clear. As Mara: read the ritual lines after Endorse and after Withhold. Not operated this pass: a failed roll, an NPC partner, a lapse on scene finish beyond ending the scene, the Attune submit and its refusals, the withhold button, a second character on one account.`

## Comparison detail

Screen 1, the ritual editor. Unset state (y03, y04): the two pickers with their labels, hints and inks, and a Set resonances button that is grey until a pick is made. Locked state (y05, y07): the dashed read-only boxes What you feel and What it does to them in their inks and a ghost Attune button. The typed resonance number is gone.

Screen 2, the partner answers. The card sits above the feed on the game page with the prompt, Endorse, Withhold and the fatigue line, in light and dark. The consent line and the endorsement prompt are in the live feed, and their command names are readable on both themes.

Screen 3, what Mara reads. Line one and line two match the demo's shape and wording, with placeholder resonances. The withheld line matches the demo's annotation.

Screen 4, attuning. Title, pickers, cost rows with the bracketed pick names, and the Attune and Cancel buttons match in light and dark.

Changes since the last PASS: none that render. Verdict per screen: Screen 1 matches, Screen 2 matches, Screen 3 matches, Screen 4 matches, Rituals page matches.
